sources.title: Own transparent weight storage and information-loss derivation
sources.details: Adopt the lesson definition1GiB=1024^3=1,073,741,824bytes. 2,127,532,032*4=8,510,128,128; /2^30=7.9256744384765625→7.93. *2=4,255,064,064; /2^30=3.96283721923828125→3.96. Count stays unchanged when bytes per value changes. Exercise328,128*4=1,312,512bytes=0.001222372055053711GiB; *2=656,256bytes=0.0006111860275268555GiB; both round to0.0 at2decimals. Area mean: an8x8 block with8ones and56zeros gives8/64=1/8=0.125. Strokes in distinct columns9 and15 inside the same8-wide pool block have identical reduced tensors: a later function of that reduced input cannot uniquely infer which original occurred.
